purpose: Place an event on the very boundary of another.
keywords: V dictionary + か + Vない + かのうちに
The food arrived almost before we had sat down.
The children went outside almost as soon as the bell rang.
I fell asleep almost before closing my eyes.
formation: V dictionary + か + Vない + かのうちに
restrictions: Uses the same verb twice and means almost before the first event is complete.
mistake: Do not use it for events separated by a substantial interval.
